data.narrative:
Magdrive is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Mark Stokes and Thomas Clayson that has raised $22.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a sector peer universe of 13 comparable companies across public and private markets, including public comps RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, and SATL, and private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method is applicable. This approach uses Magdrive's $22.5M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A step-ups, yielding a $56M implied value. Peer-Median analysis cannot be applied due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables in the Space & Aerospace sector (only one same-stage peer available; three or more required for statistical reliability). Public-Comp Anchoring using the sector's 24.4x P/S median is inapplicable absent the target's revenue disclosure, standard for early-stage private companies.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $48M to $65M, with a median of $56M. This range reflects conservative and elevated scenarios around the single Stage-Progression estimate. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for Magdrive's specific subsector within aerospace, the absence of revenue or comparable transaction data, and limited peer depth in early-stage space technology. A revenue-based valuation refresh would strengthen conviction once disclosure becomes feasible.
